data_sources.description: 10000 iterations per n (5,10,15,20), each with margin, se_l, se_d, snr, agree, eta2 per definition type and recipe variant
Per-n aggregated margin_mean, margin_std, SE values, observed agreement, mechanism classification, extrapolation fits
Original truncated-first-20 raw density data for 7 tasks (3 listing, 3 detail, 1 cart)

analysis_commands: python3: load snr_per_iteration_tag_entropy.json.gz, extract canonical DEF-FULL-MAP margins per n
python3: compute mean(M_i) and std(M_i, ddof=1) across 10000 iterations per n
python3: compute Phi(mean/std) = 0.5*(1+erf(SNR/sqrt(2))) as predicted agreement
python3: validate against frozen observed agreement targets (n=15: 0.4998, n=20: 0.5595)
python3: scipy.stats.linregress for power-law extrapolation of |margin| and margin_std to n=50
python3: bootstrap PI90 (n_boot=2000, seed=999) for extrapolation uncertainty

material_artifacts.description: This file: experiment provenance and reproduction instructions

reproduction.key_computation: For each n in [5,10,15,20]: mean_M = mean(margins), std_M = std(margins, ddof=1), SNR = mean_M/std_M, Phi = 0.5*(1+erf(SNR/sqrt(2)))
